_comment: 予愿安洁莉娜 (char_1015_aglna2) — added by the project owner, not part of the official season.
She exists in the official character_table (6* SPECIAL / skywalker 巡空者, nation 罗德岛, hidden
faction 叙拉古) but the official act2autochess chess roster (charChessDataDict) does not include
her, so the data pipeline would never emit her. This spec supplies ONLY the season-side fields
the roster would have supplied: tier, shop slot, bonds, garrison (特质) and the base/golden chess
status. Every combat field (stats, trait, attack classification, range, skills, talents, the
S3 summon) is still derived from the official tables by tools/build-data.mjs — nothing about her
fighting power is invented here.
Design notes (tier / bonds / garrison) — see docs/CUSTOM-OPERATORS.md:
* tier 6 / price 4 follows every other tier-6 chess; her closest official analogue is 新约能天使
(chess_char_6_13_a), the other 6* SPECIAL alter of the season. Base = PHASE_2 lv1 / elite = PHASE_2 lv60, the
tier-6 convention (cf. 新约能天使 / 安洁莉娜), so all three skills are unlocked at both statuses and S3 (her
signature) is the default. NOTE: she could also be placed in the tier-1 shop (chess_char_1_21_a, price 2) for
testing — that tier's convention is an E1 base, which locks S3 until the elite is merged.
* unimplementedTokens: S3's official overrideTokenKey summons token_10071_aglna2_agairp (「"一会儿见！"」), an
ability-less marker with no upstream art at all. The kit implements S3's 对空庇护 as a buff on her instead, so
the token is dropped from the character table entry rather than advertised as a summon that never appears.
* base/golden status mirrors her prototype 安洁莉娜 (chess_char_5_20_a/_b): PHASE_2 lv1 ->
PHASE_2 lv60. equipLevel 1 with no module id matches 蒂比, the season's other 巡空者.
* bonds 【叙拉古】(core, her hidden faction) + 【奇迹】(her prototype's second bond; 予愿
'grant a wish' -> miracle) + 【迅捷】(the skywalker/mobility bond 蒂比 also carries).
* garrison 「予愿」 is two traits, as the official multi-trait operators do (维娜·维多利亚 garrison_53 + _54):
(1) at the end of prep, 安洁莉娜's own refresh-driven add — +8 / +16 layers PER REFRESH this round, hard-capped
at 24 / 48 layers (SERVER_ADD_REFRESH_CNT_MULTIPLIER_BOND_LAYER, cf. her prototype garrison_147_a/_b), applied
to all three bonds; (2) in battle, this operator's ATK +2% / +4% per 3 layers of those bonds (GAIN_BUFF /
act1autochess_gar_eff_attrByBond, cf. 圣聆初雪 garrison_05_a). Trait (1) fires from the board or the bench and
only for bonds that are actually active, like every 特质 of this shape.
